page.overview:
Who is Ovarto Bitolo-Bash?

Ovarto Bitolo-Bash was a male operative in the security team led by Alys Ongwa on Corellia. When the crew was assigned to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during a visit to Coronet City on Corellia, Ovarto, alongside Barchibar, reported for Ground Team Six in the crowd present for Soh's appearance.
